entries.title: Sources: despite Trump's denial, he was told at least twice in seven months about Huang's affair with an alleged spy, including by Rubio en route to China (New York Times)
Google Fi launches "super network" for automatic carrier switching and Wi-Fi Auto-Connect+ to improve indoor connectivity in places like malls and airports (Sam Rutherford/Engadget)
Nvidia hires law firm Wachtell Lipton to investigate Jensen Huang's affair with an alleged Chinese spy, to be led by former acting US attorney Joon H. Kim (New York Times)
Updated S-1: Anthropic commits ~$10B more to Microsoft and Google cloud by 2033; it can cancel a $34.9B Lambda deal over a delay but doesn't currently plan to (Aaron Holmes/The Information)
Sources: Citigroup, Goldman Sachs, and others in a 21-bank consortium committed around $270M to fund five years of a stablecoin venture announced in September (Bloomberg)
Alta, which is building blockchain infrastructure for banks and payment companies, raised a $47.5M Series A, bringing its total funding to $80M (Kyle Baird/The Block)
OpenAI launches Businesses in ChatGPT in beta, including Business Agents for companies to interact with users and a hub where companies can claim their profiles (Jay Peters/The Verge)
The AI Futures Project updates its AI timelines after METR's report on Anthropic R&D, saying it now expects a Superhuman AI Researcher to arrive in 2027 (AI Futures Project)
Oura agrees to acquire AI and on-demand doctor service Counsel Health for $625M, says Q4 revenue grew 153% YoY to $533M and FY 2026 revenue grew 92% to $1.75B (Mark Gurman/Bloomberg)
How Alice Huang built her career with romantic partner and Hexi Capital founder Kang Wei, who faced stock market probes; sources believe she is back in China (Financial Times)
Anthropic unveils office tools, including a video call assistant, a data dashboard, and spreadsheet service Claude Sheets, in a bid to compete with Microsoft (Shirin Ghaffary/Bloomberg)
New York Governor Kathy Hochul launches the US' first effort to independently test AI systems and train a new generation of AI safety experts via a new center (Calder McHugh/Politico)
Dreeze, launched by Zerto founders to help companies recover from cyberattacks by restoring entire cloud applications, emerges from stealth with a $33M seed (CTech)
Updated S-1: Anthropic's seven co-founders will sell $1.75B of stock in next week's IPO, each offering shares worth ~$250M at the midpoint of its IPO range (Dylan Sloan/Bloomberg)
SoftBank wrote off $3.7B in non-refundable data center equipment advances after reviewing its plans in Q2; the company had committed $9.5B in advance payments (Martin Peers/The Information)
